names._aka_note: 'aspirin' is a generic name in US/UK/France; a registered Bayer trademark in Germany, Canada, Mexico, 80+ countries (frame-relative identity by space-scope). 'ASA' is the Canadian generic name because the trademark persists there. '2-acetyloxybenzoic acid' is the IUPAC systematic name.

abstraction._comment: Contextual-scale dial (spec §2.2). acetylsalicylic acid is the GENERIC compound rung. Above it: no cataloged parent yet (organic acid / salicylate class would be the next rung up — sweep-2 candidate). Below it: proposed:bayer-aspirin (brand-of relation). The abstraction LEVEL is frame-relative by jurisdiction: the compound name 'aspirin' is generic (no trademark) in the US, but the name 'Aspirin' is a branded instance rung in Germany/Canada/Mexico. This is the genericide pattern — the abstraction dial reads differently under different space-frame settings.
abstraction._level_derivation: No instance-of or brand-of out-edge from this entity; proposed:bayer-aspirin has brand-of IN-edge toward this entity. Default level = generic (no out-edge up). Overridden by scope in level_by_scope.

ladder._generalizes_to_note: No catalog entry yet for the parent class (salicylate, or organic acid). Proposed sweep-2 candidate: proposed:salicylate-class.
ladder._specializes_to_note: proposed:bayer-aspirin is the branded specific (brand-of relation backed by l0-acetylsalicylic-acid-r0002). Additional branded generics (e.g. Ecotrin, Bufferin) are not yet cataloged — sweep-2 candidates.

level_by_scope._scope_note: US: 'aspirin' is a generic name since 1921 Learned Hand ruling (Bayer Co. v. United Drug Co., 272 F.505). DE/CA: 'Aspirin' is Bayer's registered trademark; the compound is the generic underneath, but the NAME is an instance rung. This is the abstraction dial demonstrated in a second kind (brand-of as jurisdiction-relative): the level of the NAME changes under different space-frame readings while the compound itself is invariant. The contextual-scale dial is not dialed by knowledge or time here, but by the space-frame (jurisdiction).

kernel._comment: Kernel admission rule (spec §2.3): bucket=corroborated AND certainty>=0.7 AND no ESTIMATE/PROXY tag. All facts are currently pending (sweep-1 emit; no verifications yet). NO facts qualify for the kernel yet — kernel is empty at sweep-1 emit, which is correct and honest signal. The membrane holds all facts pending battle. Kernel will grow as verifications land in sweep-2.
kernel._empty_kernel_note: All facts are verification:pending at sweep-1 emit. Kernel admission requires bucket=corroborated (at least one independent verification). Empty kernel = unbattled membrane, not a data gap. See membrane.pending for the full pending population.

membrane._comment: The fuzzy frontier — facts at various hardening stages. All are pending at sweep-1. Hardness proxy: h = B(bucket) x certainty where B(pending)=0.55. Render as fuzzy/translucent per spec §3.1. DISCLOSURE: l0-membrane-proxy-v0.1 is a RENDER PROXY, not a measurement — disclose wherever drawn.

pending._dispute_flag: Attribution between Hoffmann and Eichengrün is actively disputed — see membrane.disputed

pending.value: 1921 (US only — Bayer Co. v. United Drug Co., S.D.N.Y., Judge Learned Hand)
irreversible COX-1/COX-2 inhibition via serine acetylation; suppresses prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis

disputed.value: Felix Hoffmann (lab notebooks August 10, 1897; Bayer's credited account)

disputed_alternatives.claimed_by: Arthur Eichengrün (1949 paper in Pharmazie; supported by Walter Sneader 1999)
disputed_alternatives.alternative_value: Arthur Eichengrün directed the synthesis; Hoffmann merely executed lab work without knowing the purpose
disputed_alternatives.notes: Eichengrün first raised claim in 1944 letter from Theresienstadt concentration camp; published 1949. Walter Sneader reappraisal (1999) found Eichengrün's account 'convincing and correct.' Bayer maintains Hoffmann's credit citing lab notebooks. No consensus as of knowledge cutoff. This is a genuine scholarly dispute — BOTH values carried at the membrane.

disputed._render_note: Render as membrane-under-attack (warn-color accents per spec §3.1). Both values visible on hover.

open_questions.question: Was acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) on the original 1977 WHO Essential Medicines List at its founding, or added in a subsequent edition?
open_questions.proposed_route: Fetch the actual 1977 WHO Technical Report Series No. 615 (first EML) from the WHO IRIS archive (https://iris.who.int/handle/10665/41400) and check the list contents directly. The Wikidata entry says 'since 1977' but no primary WHO document was verified in sweep-1.

open_questions.question: Exact date of Gerhardt's 1853 synthesis — was it a specific month/publication, and what journal?
open_questions.proposed_route: Check Gerhardt's original 1853 publication. Wikipedia Charles Frédéric Gerhardt article references 'Clarification on publications concerning the synthesis of acetylsalicylic acid' (Lafont, 1996) in Revue d'Histoire de la Pharmacie — fetch this for the primary publication citation.

open_questions.question: Do relations exist between acetylsalicylic-acid and any of the other five sweep-1 samples (smartphone, iphone-15-pro, claude, alan-turing, turing-enigma-hodges) beyond the institutional-web sweep-2 path?
open_questions.proposed_route: No direct factual relation found in sweep-1 between ASA and the other five entities. The honest report: cross-links are absent at this level. Sweep-2 will pull in proposed:bayer as an institution node beside proposed:apple and proposed:anthropic — that is the institutional-web connection path noted in the spec §5 entity description. The edges do NOT exist at the compound level in sweep-1; they will appear at the institution level in sweep-2.

open_questions.question: Current cardiovascular guidelines tension: is aspirin's antiplatelet use for primary prevention now affirmatively contra-indicated or merely not recommended for 60+?
open_questions.proposed_route: Fetch the 2022 USPSTF final recommendation statement on aspirin use for primary prevention (https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/aspirin-use-to-prevent-cardiovascular-disease-preventive-medication) for the precise recommendation language and age thresholds.

frames._estimate_note: MANDATORY DISCLOSURE: these weights are AUTHORED RENDER ESTIMATES, not measured quantities and not substrate facts. time=0.6: lifecycle span ~170 years (1853-present), moderate temporal depth. space=0.8: the genericide creates a strong space-frame (jurisdiction) dependency — the compound's abstraction LEVEL changes by geography, making space the most distinctive frame for this entity. knowledge=0.7: mechanism of action discovered 1971 (COX), clinical guidelines actively evolving, notable knowledge-frame relevance. meaning=0.5: moderate — the brand/generic tension carries cultural meaning (Bayer, WWI, genericide), but lower than purely cultural entities. Any toy/viewer rendering these weights owes an adjacent estimate/proxy disclosure (UI_GUIDELINES §5).

lifecycle.description: Charles Frédéric Gerhardt synthesized acetylsalicylic acid for the first time (impure, unstable form)
Pure, stable form synthesized at Bayer (attributed to Felix Hoffmann; disputed by Eichengrün)
Bayer settled on 'Aspirin' as the trade name
US genericide: Bayer Co. v. United Drug Co. (272 F.505, S.D.N.Y.), Judge Learned Hand rules 'aspirin' generic for consumers in US
lifecycle._scope_note: Genericide is US-specific. Germany/Canada/Mexico trademark retained. Use scope field when rendering lifecycle in abstraction-ladder layout with scope toggle.

lifecycle.description: John Vane publishes COX-inhibition mechanism of action (1982 Nobel Prize)

relations._note: Bayer AG — proposed:bayer is a sweep-2 entity candidate (institution kind). Also connects to proposed:apple and proposed:anthropic at the same institutional rung in the group constellation.

frame_layer._comment: D3 shape per SCHEMA_v2, reused verbatim. Analytic estimate — not a substrate fact.
frame_layer._estimate_note: AUTHORED ANALYTIC ESTIMATE, not a substrate fact. Physical: the compound is a molecular substance — it is manufactured, has measurable mass, melting point, formula. Physical membership high (0.8). Latent: the 'Aspirin' brand/concept exists as a latent wrapper whose abstraction level varies by jurisdiction — the genericide pattern is a latent phenomenon (legal/cultural, not physical). Latent membership moderate (0.5). Straddle classification. Proxy-disclosure mandatory wherever rendered.
